result.title: Kronecker-Structured Video Completion with Cross-Fitted Self-Supervised Residual Learning
result.summary: Tube-wise video completion reconstructs temporal trajectories at spatial locations unobserved in every frame. We propose a two-stage framework combining regularized masked Kronecker product decomposition (KPD) with cross-fitted self-supervised residual learning. First, we estimate a compact structural backbone directly from observed entries using cyclic component-wise least-squares updates, spatial and temporal factor regularization, and regularizer-optimal scale balancing. The exact updates yield a nonincreasing objective. Second, we address the mismatch between in-sample fitting errors and the prediction errors encountered at missing tubes. We partition observed tubes into folds and construct residual targets using backbone models fitted without the corresponding target tubes. A lightweight 3-D convolutional neural network then predicts corrections from the backbone, visible residual context, observation mask, and local detail features. Exact data consistency preserves observed measurements. Experiments include ablations, sensitivity analysis, grayscale and RGB video completion, and structured missing patterns. Our method achieves the highest mean PSNR and SSIM at the higher tested sampling rates on the grayscale benchmark. On eight selected DAVIS RGB sequences, it achieves the highest mean missing-region PSNR and full-frame SSIM and the lowest mean missing-tube temporal-gradient MAE at every evaluated sampling rate.

AI.brief_summary: 提出两阶段 tube-wise 视频补全框架：先用带正则的 masked Kronecker 积分解从观测条目估计紧凑结构骨架，再用交叉拟合构造的自监督残差目标训练轻量 3D CNN 预测修正量，并在灰度与 DAVIS RGB 序列上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「交叉拟合」以不含目标 tube 的模型构造残差监督、避免样本内拟合泄漏，可能为 latent 轨迹的残差修正与监督分配提供可核查线索，但任务与 VLM 推理相距较远。
